fields.name: to
fields.coerce: the socket wrapper puts a value that is not an array into an array (node/server.js:4926-4928). A missing `to` becomes `[undefined]` and reaches nobody
fields.description: The characters that get the message. The server skips names that are not online on this server.

fields.name: message
fields.coerce: the wrapper reads `JSON.stringify(message).length` for the call cost. Receivers get `message || ""`, so a falsy value arrives as `""`
fields.description: The data to send, usually a string. The server sends it on without change. A missing `message` makes the wrapper throw (failure row 1).

responses.name: Success
responses.when: Always when you have a character that is not muted, also when no receiver is online.

fields.name: receivers
fields.description: The names from `to` that are online on this server, in the order of `to`. Each of them got the message.

rows.when: `message` is missing. The socket wrapper reads `JSON.stringify(undefined).length` before the handler runs, and this throws. The wrapper adds 16 call-cost.

confirm.note: When the 16 added call-cost goes over the limit, the server sends `limitdcreport` and `disconnect_reason` and disconnects instead

rows.when: No character, or your character has the `mute` condition.

also.when: Success, before the `game_response`, in the order of `to`.

fields.name: message
fields.description: The `message` of the request, or `""` if it was falsy.
